| Title | Author | Why It’s Worth Your Time |

| **“The Overstory”** | Richard Powers | Interweaves the lives of eight characters with the lives of trees, delivering an epic meditation on ecology, activism, and interconnectedness. |
| **“Exit West”** | Mohsin Hamid | A romantic‑fantasy spin on the refugee crisis: doors act as portals that instantly transport people to new countries, allowing a love story to explore migration and belonging. |

| Title | Creator(s) | Why Read |
|-------|------------|----------|
| **“Maus”** | Art Spiegelman | Pulitzer‑winning graphic memoir that portrays the Holocaust with mice (Jews) and cats (Nazis)—a powerful, innovative blend of history and personal testimony. |

## 📖 Quick “Pick‑One‑For‑Any‑Mood” List
